reason: Bridges the Codex CLI into DeepSeek Harness as a managed agent tool, supporting parallel sessions, continuation, process control, and a live conversation-pane view of activity and results.

summaries.zh: 将 Codex CLI 集成为 DeepSeek Harness 中可管理的智能体工具，支持并行会话、线程续接、进程控制以及在对话面板中查看活动和结果。
summaries.en: Integrates the Codex CLI as a managed agent tool in DeepSeek Harness with parallel sessions, thread continuation, process control, and live activity and result viewing in the conversation pane.

capabilities: Starts and manages Codex CLI processes
Runs Codex in a session working directory
Supports read-only or workspace-write sandbox modes
Streams session status, tool activity, transcripts, and results
Continues settled Codex sessions on the same thread
